item.title: OSSTEC Appoints Dr. Nick Pachuda to Board and Establishes US Operations Ahead of US Market Entry
item.description: OSSTEC today announced updates supporting its US market entry: The appointment of Dr. Nick Pachuda to its Board of Directors. The post OSSTEC Appoints Dr. Nick Pachuda to Board and Establishes US Operations Ahead of US Market Entry appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Maxx Orthopedics Acquires TracPatch®, Expanding QRS® Platform into a Fully Integrated Recovery Ecosystem
item.description: Maxx Orthopedics Inc. has acquired TracPatch®, a wearable sensor technology designed to improve patient recovery by tracking key recovery metrics in real-time. The post Maxx Orthopedics Acquires TracPatch®, Expanding QRS® Platform into a Fully Integrated Recovery Ecosystem appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: THINK Surgical Announces First Clinical Cases with the TMINI® Miniature Robotic System and the Stryker® Triathlon® Knee System
item.description: THINK Surgical, Inc. announced first cases have been completed using the TMINI® Miniature Robotic System combined with Stryker®'s Triathlon® Knee System. The post THINK Surgical Announces First Clinical Cases with the TMINI® Miniature Robotic System and the Stryker® Triathlon® Knee System appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Fans Cheer AOSSM’s New General Manager: Corey J. Parker, MPA
item.description: AOSSM has unanimously selected Corey J. Parker, M.P.A., as its next Chief Executive Officer. The post Fans Cheer AOSSM’s New General Manager: Corey J. Parker, MPA appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: TJO Surpasses 50,000 Implants Placed, with 32% of Procedures Performed in ASCs
item.description: Total Joint Orthopedics, Inc. (TJO) today announced it has surpassed 50,000 total implants placed nationwide, including more than 38,000 Klassic® Knee implants. The post TJO Surpasses 50,000 Implants Placed, with 32% of Procedures Performed in ASCs appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Does Bone Quality Really Doom Your ACDF?
item.description: You scroll through the CT. You glance at the Hounsfield units (HU). You squint. “Hmm. That bone doesn’t look great…” The post Does Bone Quality Really Doom Your ACDF? appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: FDA Approves (PMA) Dynamic Sagittal Tethering for Spondy
item.description: Significant PMA announcement from the FDA: Dynamic Sagittal Tethering approved for commercial sale. The post FDA Approves (PMA) Dynamic Sagittal Tethering for Spondy appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: 2nd FDA Clearance for Novel Instument Sterilization System
item.description: FDA grants a second 510(k) clearance for an expanded approved storage window in Innovative Sterilization Technologies ONE TRAY® system. The post 2nd FDA Clearance for Novel Instument Sterilization System appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Maxx Orthopedics Expands Libertas® Hip Portfolio with the Introduction of the Keystone™ Hip System
item.description: Maxx Orthopedics, Inc. today announces the launch of the Libertas® Keystone™ Hip System, a short, metaphyseal fit-and-fill hip stem. The post Maxx Orthopedics Expands Libertas® Hip Portfolio with the Introduction of the Keystone™ Hip System appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.

item.title: Xtant Medical Finalizes Companion Spine Transactions
item.description: Xtant received $10.7 million in satisfaction of unsecured promissory note issued to Xtant by Companion Spine plus related working capital adjustments. The post Xtant Medical Finalizes Companion Spine Transactions appeared first on Orthopedics This Week.
